claims.claim: Dataset construction is an explicitly stated substantive contribution, not inferred from experimental data volume.

caveats: Correction targets use an advanced proprietary editor; correction supervision inherits its limitations (AppendixA).
Official dataset/code availability, licenses, source-image disjointness and successful execution were not audited; public download alone is not an R1/R2 acceptance criterion.
Table2 HPSv3 full6.20 versus own single-step6.23 and prose-highest wording remain explicit.
The fifty-image human sample and20raters do not establish universal evaluation validity; no rater agreement/causal claim is independently reproduced.
Preserve detection task; do not add correction or localization tasks in this wave.

Independent QC: Figure5 opening says strict3-point scale, while per-category definitions and AppendixC specify binary0/1 for each of three categories. Retain this wording ambiguity; do not invent a three-valued scale or silently repair the prompt.
